caseName: G. & K. Manufacturing Co. v. Commissioner
caseNameFull: G. & K. Manufacturing Co. v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Llewellyn A. Luce for petitioner., Solicitor General Reed, Assistant Attorney General Wideman, and Messrs. Sewall Key and J. Louis Monarch for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit granted limited to the question of the application of the statutory provisions as to reorganization.
